_note: Experiments registry (roadmap block 6, 2026-09-14). Luke owns this file; the 11 AM cron reads it as the truth and writes each entry DOWN into the row of the All Gyms sheet's Experiments tab whose Experiment ID equals sheet_id (a missing row is appended). Chris reads, he does not type. arms = the outreach-log tags that put a send in each arm (SHIFT's Mailchimp journey tags). primary_outcome is one of opened_7d, clicked_7d, responded_14d, returned_30d, converted_30d, converted_60d, redeemed_30d (default returned_30d). baseline = the rate expected without a change, mwe = the smallest improvement worth acting on (fraction, default 0.05). started = the date the test went live, for the record. Set active to false to freeze a row.

experiments._bucket_note: Bucket test (Tasks step 2.2, built 2026-09-23, GATED OFF). Everyone who gets a survey email on or after population.since is in the test; the arm is the hash of email + 'survey_reminder_ab', the same hash the survey_reminder trigger uses to decide who gets the reminder. Arm A sends nothing, so it has no tag. Judged on answered within 14 days of the FIRST survey email. Baseline 1.3% / MWE +2.6 pts = the ROADMAP Block 10 timing row (587 per arm, about 29 weeks at SHIFT alone, 18 pooled); re-estimate at launch if the embed email is the standard by then (answers about 3%). The swap commit sets active:true, started and population.since to the start morning.
